articles.title: Cosplaying as a street photographer with the iPhone Duo is ridiculous and kinda fun.

But you’re definitely gonna get called out when someone spots it, and the fish-slinging folks at the Pike Place Fish Market don’t miss a beat. They were kind enough to help me test the selfie camera, at least.
